name: Aberrant Mind
summary: Sorcerers changed by an alien influence, gifted with psionic power.

features.name: Psionic Spells
features.short: Learn extra psionic spells you can swap for divination or enchantment.
features.summary: You learn additional spells at the listed sorcerer levels; they don't count against your spells known. You can replace one with a divination or enchantment spell when you level up.

features.name: Telepathic Speech
features.short: Bonus action: telepathic link with a creature for minutes.
features.summary: As a bonus action, choose a creature within 30 ft.: you can speak telepathically with each other while within miles equal to your CHA modifier, for minutes equal to your sorcerer level.

features.name: Psionic Sorcery
features.short: Cast psionic spells with sorcery points, without components.
features.summary: When you cast a 1st-level or higher Psionic Spell, you can spend sorcery points equal to its level instead of a slot; then it needs no verbal or somatic components (and no material ones without a cost).

features.name: Psychic Defenses
features.short: Resist psychic; advantage against charm and fear.
features.summary: You gain resistance to psychic damage and advantage on saves against being charmed or frightened.

features.name: Revelation in Flesh
features.short: Spend sorcery points to fly, swim, see invisible or squeeze.
features.summary: As a bonus action, spend 1+ sorcery points to transform for 10 minutes, choosing per point: see invisible within 60 ft., fly at your walking speed, swim at double speed and breathe water, or squeeze through 1-inch spaces.

features.name: Warping Implosion
features.short: Teleport and pull nearby creatures in for 3d10 force.
features.summary: As an action, you teleport up to 120 ft. Each creature within 30 ft. of where you left makes a STR save or takes 3d10 force damage and is pulled toward that space. Once per long rest (or 5 sorcery points).
